title: convolvulus quamoclit
intro: Convolvulus quamoclit, commonly known as the coral creeper or star glory vine, is a flowering plant in the morning glory family. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus quamoclit include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Convolvulus quamoclit include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
